description: This file defines the 'Session' class within the 'Opencart\System\Library' namespace. The class manages session operations such as starting a session, retrieving session ID, closing, destroying, and garbage collection. It interacts with different session adaptors dynamically loaded based on the provided adaptor type.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: A class responsible for managing HTTP session lifecycle and data storage using various adaptors.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new session or resumes an existing one, generating a session ID if necessary.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Saves session data to storage and closes the session.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the current session data from storage.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection of session data.
